targetReviews.name: meanPredict_comparator_decomposition
targetReviews.exactHeader:
theorem meanPredict_comparator_decomposition (y : ℕ → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (T : ℕ) :
    comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2) (meanPredict y) u T =
      comparatorRegret (fun t x => (x - y t)^2)
        (meanPredict y) (empiricalMean y T) T -
      (T : ℝ) * (u - empiricalMean y T)^2

definitionAudit.name: comparatorRegret
definitionAudit.logicalExpansion: No Prop assumptions. Two finite sums over0,...,T-1, the comparator is the sameu throughout. Generic carrier need not be a vector space; feasibility is not part of the definition.
definitionAudit.sourceDelta: Source general regret usesV⊂ℝ^d and feasible predictions; the API generalizes to arbitraryX. Specialized mean predictor is feasible underhy, a derived property rather than an added premise.
definitionAudit.exactText:
noncomputable def comparatorRegret {X : Type*} (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) (u : X) (T : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t (prediction t)) - ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, loss t u
definitionAudit.binderClassification: All carriers, values, functions and finite indices are TYPING. There is no hidden source hypothesis bundle; LimitNoRegret quantified body is expanded explicitly above.

definitionAudit.name: LimitNoRegret
definitionAudit.logicalExpansion: ∀u:X, u∈V → ∃a:ℝ, a<=0 AND Tendsto (T↦comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a). u precedesa;T is the limit variable. No feasibility of predictions is encoded. V=empty makes it vacuous.
definitionAudit.sourceDelta: Faithful finite-ordinary interpretation of printed lim<=0 in the bounded square-loss specialization. General unbounded-loss finite versus extended limit ambiguity remains outside this packet; API does not encode limsup or extended-real limits.
definitionAudit.zero: Finite changes at horizon0 do not affect atTop.
definitionAudit.exactText:
def LimitNoRegret {X : Type*} (V : Set X) (loss : ℕ → X → ℝ)
    (prediction : ℕ → X) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ V, ∃ a : ℝ, a ≤ 0 ∧
    Tendsto (fun T : ℕ => comparatorRegret loss prediction u T / T) atTop (nhds a)
